title: Go-live checks and stakeholder handoff
summary: Working checklist and owner matrix for customer go-live handoff. Focused on inference-specific readiness: model pinning, latency SLO verification, KV cache priming, billing/quota setup, and post-launch monitoring runbook. This is an informal, actionable doc intended for the Customer Success manager + SRE/Serving-runtime leads to agree on owners and mitigation plan prior to QBR and renewal conversations.
milestones: Env provisioning completed (VPC peering + route tables) | Owner: Hannah Li | Due: 2025-10-20 | Status: complete | Acceptance: successful private control plane heartbeats x24h
Model pinning and artifact sync to customer registry | Owner: Miguel Ortega | Due: 2025-10-27 | Status: at_risk | Acceptance: pinned model v1.2.0 available in dedicated pool, sha verified
Canary traffic switch (10% -> 50% -> 100%) | Owner: Priya Menon | Due: 2025-11-03 | Status: in_progress | Acceptance: p50 latency <120ms, error rate <0.5% across steps
KV/prefix cache warmup completed for top-10 endpoints | Owner: Samir Patel | Due: 2025-11-01 | Status: blocked | Acceptance: cache hit >=75% for top-10 prompts
Cost/runbook signoff (billing alerts & quotas) | Owner: Finance CS Liaison - Ayesha Khan | Due: 2025-10-30 | Status: in_progress | Acceptance: budget alerts configured, escalation path documented

Post-launch monitoring runbook & alerting playbook | Owner: SRE (Jules Becker) | Due: 2025-11-05 | Status: in_progress | Acceptance: dashboards for per-route p95, token-cost per-request, rollback runbook documented
Customer acceptance & success criteria signed | Owner: Priya Menon | Due: 2025-11-10 | Status: planned | Acceptance: customer sign-off on SLA metrics and rollout schedule
acceptance_criteria: Latency: p95 below agreed SLA per route (customer-specific thresholds in linked Confluence)
Reliability: sustained error rate <= 1% for 72h under expected load
Cost: unit token cost within 15% of projection OR approved variance from finance
Observability: tracing and token-level breakdowns enabled; at least 3 alerting rules live
Security: KMS integration validated and audit logs visible to customer via Console
blockers_and_mitigations: Blocked: KV cache warmup failing for autocomplete endpoint (high cold-start miss rate). Mitigation: prioritize small warmup dataset, enable prefix caching, schedule targeted warmup job overnight (owner: Samir).

Risk: Model quantization VS accuracy regression for customer model. Mitigation: temporary fallback to unquantized variant during canary; run eval set and compare logits-based drift metric (owner: Miguel).

Dependency: Dedicated GPU capacity allocated by infra team delayed by 3 days. Mitigation: short-term traffic routing to hosted pool with rate limit and cost alert; escalate via infra on-call (owner: Hannah).
Open question: SLA window for maintenance (customer asked for 23:00-03:00 ET). Action: confirm with SRE and put in rollout schedule (owner: Priya).
next_steps: Priya: confirm customer sign-off meeting time and share final milestones by EOD Friday
Miguel: run quantized vs unquantized eval and upload results to linked PR by 2025-10-24
Samir: schedule cache-warmup job and attach logs to this doc once executed
Hannah: update infra ticket with new ETA and confirm temporary hosted fallback capacity
Jules (SRE): create dashboard template and populate with demo data for QBR
notes: Notes to self: keep the canary window short (<48h) if regression observed. Use Slack channel #cs-acme-genomics for rapid comms. There are a few one-off customer prompts that consistently push sequence length to 4k — need to decide on truncation vs specialized route.
